corrections.text: The summary says Amazon, Gartner, Revolut and GitHub 'each pairs token or request counts with caveats', and a bolded Implications heading says 'Every source pairs input counts with a caveat'. The cited sources support this for Amazon's memo, the Gartner analyst quoted by InfoWorld and GitHub's changelog entries only. The Register's Revolut report contains no caveat about token or request counts (the note that its 60 and 70 percent figures lack a stated method is the article's own), and the TechCrunch item reports a spend figure with no caveat or output measure. The summary also calls David Abitbol Revolut's 'engineering lead'; The Register describes him as ops and infrastructure lead.
